The '''Solo Strobe''' was a personal location device manufactured by [[Saladar Systems]]. The function of the Solo Strobe was to allow a lost being to indicate their position to a rescue team. Although not designed for such, it could also be used as an impromptu weapon, able to blind an attacker.<ref name="PSG" />
